key_highlights: ASX inched higher on energy and big miner rally, but BHP faces pressure as iron ore prices crumble
Santos boosts Papua LNG stake as ExxonMobil assumes operatorship, reshaping Australia's LNG landscape
Australian housing price falls accelerate dramatically; RBA signals it will not intervene to support property
Mortgage costs driving Australians into second jobs; consumer sentiment deteriorating
Gold exploration surge: Forrestania hits 2Moz, Larvotto strikes gold-antimony-tungsten in NSW, Kaiser reloads Tassie inventory
BYD declares Australia has passed EV tipping point, pressuring traditional auto and insurance sectors
Qantas engine flame incident raises aviation safety and insurance concerns
Stokes family retakes control of Seven Network, reshaping ASX-listed media landscape
AI trade rotation: AMD/Intel outperform Nvidia; Hut 8 pivots to AI via $35B Anthropic deal
Tanker wars assessed as insufficient to suppress oil prices, supporting energy sector

sectors.trend: Mixed: iron ore weakness pressures BHP and FMG, but gold and uranium exploration activity is robust. Forrestania's 2Moz milestone, Larvotto's NSW strike, and Kaiser's Tassie expansion signal a gold sector upcycle. Aureka's $8.9M Victorian acquisition signals consolidation at the junior end.
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face headwinds from soft iron ore. Gold juniors (FOR.AX, KAE.AX, LAR.AX) and uranium (INF.AX) offer relative strength. Diversification within materials is key.

sectors.trend: Santos' expanded Papua LNG stake with ExxonMobil operatorship is a structural positive for STO.AX. Tanker wars deemed insufficient to suppress oil, providing a floor for energy names. Graziers challenging energy zones add regulatory uncertainty to renewables.
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX) and Woodside (WDS.AX) benefit from LNG project momentum. Coal and oil names supported by tanker-war-driven supply risk premium. Renewables face community opposition risk.

sectors.trend: Accelerating housing price falls and RBA's refusal to intervene create credit risk for CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX. Mortgage stress driving second-job uptake signals rising NPL risk. RBA unlikely to cut aggressively.
sectors.implications: Bank NPL provisions may rise in coming quarters. Rate-sensitive REITs under pressure. Defensive positioning in banks warranted until housing stabilises.

sectors.trend: BYD declares Australia's EV tipping point passed, pressuring traditional auto dealers and insurers. Car supply crunch writing off vehicles early and inflating insurance premiums. Consumer squeeze from mortgage costs evident.
sectors.implications: Insurance names (WBC.AX, CGF.AX) face rising claims. Auto retailers under structural pressure. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOL.AX) may see defensive rotation.

sectors.trend: Stokes family retakes Seven Network control, creating governance uncertainty for the ASX-listed entity. Global AI trade rotating from Nvidia to AMD/Intel; Hut 8's Anthropic deal signals AI infrastructure demand shift.
sectors.implications: Seven (SVL.AX) faces control-change volatility. Australian tech exposure limited; global AI rotation may lift sentiment for any ASX-listed tech proxies.

sectors.trend: No major ASX healthcare headlines today. Housing price acceleration negatively impacts property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICQ.AX). RBA's hands-off stance removes rate-cut catalyst for REITs.
sectors.implications: REITs remain under pressure. CSL.AX and SGH.AX unaffected by today's headlines; maintain as defensive anchors.

Housing downturn accelerating with no RBA rescue in sight

LNG project momentum supporting energy sector
Media consolidation via Stokes family return to Seven

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce large-cap iron ore exposure; rotate into gold and diversified miners

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Accelerating housing falls triggering bank NPL spike and credit contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor RBA statements; favour banks with lower residential exposure (CBA.AX over ANZ.AX)

risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor QAN.AX and insurance sector for claims impact

risk_assessment.risk_factor: EV transition accelerating faster than expected, disrupting auto/insurance revenue
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight legacy auto retailers; favour insurers with EV-ready underwriting

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US Fed rate hike and midterm uncertainty creating global risk-off
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain AUD-hedged positions; hold quality defensives

risk_assessment.risk_factor: El Nino 'Godzilla' event impacting agricultural and energy supply chains
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor commodity supply; favour energy and agribusiness hedges

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and uranium juniors amid exploration boom
opportunities.rationale: Forrestania 2Moz, Larvotto NSW strike, Kaiser Tassie expansion, and Infini uranium target signal a resource upcycle offsetting iron ore weakness

opportunities.recommendation: Add Santos on Papua LNG stake expansion
opportunities.rationale: ExxonMobil operatorship de-risks project execution; LNG demand structural; tanker wars support oil price floor

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into consumer staples as mortgage squeeze deepens
opportunities.rationale: Second-job uptake and deteriorating sentiment favour defensive staples over discretionary

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce large-cap iron ore exposure (BHP, FMG, RIO)
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'crumbling' per macrobusiness; BHP strategic uncertainty; China demand softness

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight property REITs and rate-sensitive financials
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing falls accelerating, RBA will not intervene, NPL risk rising for banks

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD and monitor Qantas incident fallout
defensive_moves.rationale: Fed hike risk and global uncertainty; QAN.AX and insurance sector face event risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to range with sector rotation: energy and gold outperform, iron ore and REITs lag. Housing data and RBA commentary will dominate. Qantas incident may cause brief volatility. Midterm and Fed expectations add global noise.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift toward gold/uranium and LNG over iron ore. Housing correction may extend 6-12 months without RBA intervention. EV transition accelerating. AI infrastructure demand supports tech-adjacent names. Consumer squeeze persists through 2026-27.
